fact: Lisinopril is contraindicated in patients with a history of angioedema related to previous ACE inhibitor therapy.
Metformin is contraindicated in patients with severe renal impairment (eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2).
NSAIDs, including Ibuprofen, can cause a dose-dependent reduction in prostaglandin formation and precipitate renal decompensation in patients with renal impairment.
